notes: OH 2015 mirrors the OH 2010/2025 three-regime structure under Title I State Government. Pass-3 returned per-section leaves (no further nesting). Selected 26 sections in Ch. 101 (legislative-agent 101.70-101.81 + retirement-system lobbyist 101.90-101.981 + JLEC fund 101.34 + penalty 101.99), 13 sections in Ch. 121 (executive-agency lobbyist 121.60-121.69 + penalties 121.99, 121.991), and 13 support sections in Ch. 102 (definitions, financial disclosure, ethics commission, revolving-door, penalty). 102.01 has duplicate entries for the pre/post-1/1/2018 text; chose the effective-until-1/1/2018 variant as appropriate for 2015. No Playwright/Cloudflare errors.
